Every day, Lin You bustled about in the breakfast shop, steam rising from the window as she served hot, crispy fried pancakes, golden-brown fried dough sticks, and savory meat-stuffed buns…
The human forces fighting the zombies had no shortage of food and drink, keeping their spirits high. Thanks to this breakfast shop, the city became a secure stronghold.
And so, Lin You harvested vegetables, raised dogs, cooked meals… maintaining an extremely peaceful life within the fortified walls.
Until one day, a man suddenly emerged from a vegetable basket.
He wore a neat uniform, his features handsome, his expression aloof.
“Strange, how did my interdimensional space end up here?”
Hearing the noise, Lin You turned her head—just in time to lock eyes with the man who had climbed out of a pile of radishes.
“??”
“!!”

Kang Seouk was an alpha male who only knew how to compensate for his lacking masculinity through violence, oppression, or the power he wielded.
Even so, the effort and cold rationality born from his inferiority complex had brought him immense power. But life, as always, could fall apart in an instant — and Kang Seouk was no exception.
On the day he shined the brightest — October 3rd — Kang Seouk was kidnapped. By his own biological son, Kang Yeonjae, whom he had raised like an obedient pet.

Erta Geranion, known as the “flower of high society,” harbored a secret she could never reveal to anyone. It was her hidden desires.
Unlike other young ladies who wished for tenderness, protection, and affection, Erta longed for someone to be rough with her, to humiliate her, and to dominate her.
Unable to confess these urges to anyone, she endured each day in silent torment, growing increasingly desolate—until one day.  
“Confession?”
Finally, Erta saw a glimmer of hope.
“Isn’t that meant for atoning sins?”
“Bonderidge Cathedral allows counseling as well.”  
Hearing the news that she could unburden the weight in her heart, not as a form of atonement but as a kind of counseling, Erta decided to confess her desires at Bondridge Cathedral.
“Whatever it is you wish to say, Sister, feel free to speak.”
“I… I want someone to hit me.”
“…Pardon?”
“And I want to be tied up so tightly that I can’t do anything.”  
That night, after her confession, Erta went to bed feeling at peace. But her tranquility was short-lived when an unknown man appeared in her bedroom.  
—
Slap!  
“Ahhh!”
‘W-what is this?’
Ropes tied around her wrists.
A blindfold obstructing her vision.
Her clothes torn and discarded.
And finally, hands striking her bare skin.
This moment was exactly the fantasy Erta had dreamed of.  
Thump, thump.
Her heart raced.  
‘J-just once more…’  
She even found herself wishing to be struck on her backside just once more.
‘Please…!’

Yoon Hae-in — the actress who made history as the youngest ever to draw 10 million viewers and win Best Actress at an international film festival — was once a shining star. On the day she believed would mark her greatest triumph—no, the day it should have—tragedy struck: her younger sister died.
Beside her sister’s lifeless body lay the script for Hobbit — the very work that had brought her both the highest honor and the deepest loss. That day, Hae-in began a secret search for the truth behind her sister’s death. But the trauma left her unable to even touch a script again, turning her into a broken actress.
Now, she hides in plain sight as the manager of Baek A-yeon, the reigning queen of Dog X My Way.
Seo Do-joon, heir to media giant AJ, had watched Hobbit dozens of times, clinging to the hope that the vanished star would one day live brilliantly again. When he visits Baek A-yeon’s shoot in Paris, he unexpectedly meets Hae-in—who mistakes him for an Uber driver. The woman he had once admired was living a far harsher reality than he’d imagined.
Recognizing her immediately, Do-joon makes a silent vow: he will bring Yoon Hae-in back to the top. Unable to forget her expression in Paris, he returns to Korea, taking over as CEO of AJ Entertainment, where Baek A-yeon is signed.
Soon after, he offers Hae-in a chance to audition for the lead role in a drama penned by a renowned writer.
“Do you need this kind of cheap attention? A director who makes a once-famous actress start from scratch just to be mocked?”
“Yoon Hae-in will never be a joke. She has limitless potential. And I’m betting everything on it.”
But could a woman who couldn’t even protect her own brother dare to dream of standing at the top again?
After long hesitation, Hae-in makes her choice—for her brother’s justice, and for herself.
“I longed for it… and yet I was afraid. But I want to stand again. This time, I’ll grant myself absolution.”

133165.synopsis:
Ning Xiao passed away from cancer, but unexpectedly bound herself to a mysterious rental system.
Unable to return to her original world, she followed the system’s missions, moving through different disaster worlds, collecting rent and establishing shelters.
In a city ravaged by endless snow, she created warm and cozy ice houses.
In a city overrun by mutated beasts, she built intricate treehouses that kept their inhabitants safe.
In a city swallowed by the sea, she constructed stable, secure houses on the water.
And in a city infested with zombies, she established impenetrable fortresses.
…
Survivors soon realized that the rent for these houses was not much, yet it allowed them to keep living in different disaster worlds.
Those hovering on the brink of death began to pray endlessly for the appearance of the miraculous landlord.
(The male protagonist is only a background character.)
